scope: Linux Office and spreadsheet worker child processes

layers.role: Landlock workspace restriction, fail-closed network policy, and dangerous-syscall seccomp denylist
KDV-owned fail-closed BPF filter denying socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, send, receive, shutdown, and setsockopt syscalls
Audited Linux syscall numbers and EPERM result code; no document parsing or rendering

acceptance.fully_enforced: accepted only after the KDV-owned network seccomp filter is installed
acceptance.partially_enforced: accepted only for Landlock when the skarn seccomp denylist and KDV network seccomp are both installed and no policy path was skipped
acceptance.unsupported_or_failed: worker exits before opening the document
acceptance.runtime_test: an isolated test child installs the KDV filter and must receive EPERM when creating a TCP socket

release_gate: exact direct versions and crates.io checksums are verified by scripts/release/verify-release-contract.py
decision: accepted; this preserves fail-closed isolation on Linux runners with partial Landlock ABI support without weakening resource, path, syscall, or network policy
